record.bible_text: And Hiram<WH02438> king<WH04428> of Tyre<WH06865> sent<WH07971><WTH8799> his servants<WH05650> unto Solomon<WH08010>; for he had heard<WH08085><WTH8804> that they had anointed<WH04886><WTH8804> him king<WH04428> in the room of his father<WH01>: for Hiram<WH02438> was ever<WH03117> a lover<WH0157><WTH8802> of David<WH01732>. <RF>Hiram: also called, Huram<Rf>

And it came to pass, when Hiram<WH02438> heard<WH08085><WTH8800> the words<WH01697> of Solomon<WH08010>, that he rejoiced<WH08055><WTH8799> greatly<WH03966>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Blessed<WH01288><WTH8803> <FI>be<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> this day<WH03117>, which hath given<WH05414><WTH8804> unto David<WH01732> a wise<WH02450> son<WH01121> over this great<WH07227> people<WH05971>.

So Hiram<WH02438> gave<WH05414><WTH8802> Solomon<WH08010> cedar<WH0730> trees<WH06086> and fir<WH01265> trees<WH06086> <FI>according to<Fi> all his desire<WH02656>.
